parent.parent_question_already_closed: Does dimension/representation-valid PDE coupling outperform a matched naive representation?
parent.r3_2_question: Given a dimension-valid canonical PDE interface, does adapting coupling strength to the current inference-visible state provide value beyond parameter-only adaptation?

r3_2a.name: R3-2a ParamOnly
r3_2a.meaning: Same conditioner architecture and trainable capacity as R3-2b, but current-state information is masked out. Only logRa/logPr remain visible.

r3_2b.name: R3-2b StateParam
r3_2b.meaning: Same conditioner architecture and trainable capacity as R3-2a, with current-state and current canonical-PDE-signal summaries visible.

causal_decomposition.secondary_contrast_total_interpretation: total value of state-parameter adaptive coupling

gate_parameterization.parent_raw_alpha_source: load exactly from split-matched frozen R3-1b best checkpoint
gate_parameterization.conditioner_output: delta_raw for the two active PDE terms
gate_parameterization.safety_bound: The existing fixed per-term alpha_max remains the final nonlearnable coupling-capacity bound.
gate_parameterization.epoch0_requirement: delta_raw must be exactly zero for every sample so R3-2a and R3-2b reproduce R3-1b exactly at epoch 0.

conditioner.nonfinal_initialization: identical deterministic initialization for R3-2a and R3-2b under the same seed

conditioner_features.inference_visibility_rule: Every feature must be computable from the current autoregressive prediction state, current canonical PDE signals, and Ra/Pr. No current or future GT information is allowed.

state_feature_definition.state_source: latest predicted state in the autoregressive context
state_feature_definition.pressure_exclusion_reason: R3-2 must adapt the two already-active buoyancy/velocity coupling pathways without introducing a new pressure-conditioned mechanism.

canonical_signal_feature_definition.source: the two unweighted canonical PDE coupling signals compiled at the current predicted state before adaptive gate multiplication
canonical_signal_feature_definition.space: final normalized finite-step target-delta merge space

parameter_features.definition: same log10(Ra), log10(Pr) parameter representation already used by the project

conditioner_features.reason_no_fitted_feature_normalization: Avoid introducing arm-specific feature-statistics fitting or another train-derived preprocessing degree of freedom in the R3-2 causal comparison.

required_checks: all final conditioner outputs delta_raw are exactly zero
effective alpha values exactly equal frozen R3-1b alpha values
predicted normalized delta exactly equals R3-1b
predicted next normalized state exactly equals R3-1b
embedded M6 state_dict exactly equals independently audited M6
R3-2a and R3-2b conditioner parameter tensors are identical at initialization

test_embargo.release_condition: All four seed42 R3-2 formal runs are complete under the locked architecture/training contract.

physics.split: same TEST windows as formal prediction rollout
physics.semantics: FD-based comparative proxy, not solver-level PDE violation

decision_logic.primary_question: Does current-state information improve a capacity-matched adaptive canonical coupling mechanism beyond parameter-only conditioning?
decision_logic.no_required_claim: R3-2 is not required to beat R3-1b at every individual horizon or every physics proxy to establish state-information value.
decision_logic.state_adaptation_claim_requires: A reproducible advantage of R3-2b over the capacity-matched R3-2a control under the locked validation and post-training evaluation protocol.
decision_logic.r3_3_not_allowed_to_begin_until: R3-2 matched training, rollout, physics evaluation, and causal interpretation are closed.

amendment_policy.mechanical_bug_fix: allowed only if identified before interpreting formal results, documented, regression-tested, and applied identically to both arms
amendment_policy.scientific_design_change: requires a new contract version and a fresh matched experiment; old formal results must remain intact
